about: EVAL stage 4 (entry routing). expect: open = the open tool is called once with requestText equal to the prompt; not_open = the open tool is not called; no_tool = the open tool is absent, the user says they are on GitHub Copilot CLI, and the reply explains the three causes without starting work; no_tool_claude = the open tool is absent in Claude Code, and the reply says the screen is a Copilot CLI feature and shows claude --agent and /{run}, names none of the three causes and starts no work. {run} and {screen} are the names of the batch-run skill and the screen-entry skill (read from docs/replace.md by role).
